items.stem: A company reports a profit but negative operating cash flow. What is the most likely reason?

options.text: Profit is accrual-based; cash can differ due to receivables, inventory and timing
options.rationale: Correct: accrual profit and cash flow differ because of working-capital timing.

options.text: The income statement must be wrong
options.rationale: A gap between profit and cash is normal, not necessarily an error.

options.text: Cash flow and profit are always equal
options.rationale: They are not equal under accrual accounting.
Reporting a profit implies revenue exists.

items.explanation: Correct: accrual profit and cash flow differ because of working-capital timing.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about financial ratios are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A ratio is most useful compared to a benchmark or trend
options.rationale: Correct: context from benchmarks and trends gives a ratio meaning.

options.text: High return on equity can be driven by high leverage, not just performance
options.rationale: Correct: leverage inflates ROE and must be read with caution.

options.text: The current ratio measures long-term profitability
options.rationale: The current ratio measures short-term liquidity, not profitability.

options.text: A single ratio in isolation fully describes financial health
options.rationale: No single ratio captures overall health.

items.explanation: Correct: context from benchmarks and trends gives a ratio meaning.

items.stem: Why must cash flows in different years be discounted before comparison?

options.text: A sum received later is worth less today because of the time value of money
options.rationale: Correct: discounting reflects that money has a time value.

options.text: Inflation is the only reason and it is negligible
options.rationale: The time value of money is broader than inflation and is not negligible.

options.text: Future cash flows are always larger
options.rationale: Size is irrelevant; timing requires discounting.

options.text: Accounting rules forbid adding cash flows
options.rationale: The issue is comparability across time, not a prohibition.

items.explanation: Correct: discounting reflects that money has a time value.
